title: Bad to the Bone Riff
blurb: The opening riff of Bad to the Bone — the sound of someone who thinks they're the main character. Meme culture uses it strictly ironically: the toddler in sunglasses, the cat knocking a glass off the table, anyone doing something mildly rebellious with maximum swagger. Play it when someone breaks the smallest possible rule and looks proud about it.
origin: George Thorogood's 1982 riff, repurposed by memes as ironic badass entrance music.
